Null attaching maps imply K2 ≃ A∨B∨ΣG and integral free sphere ranks. At r=3 only forbidden pairs occur inside 2q disjoint q-vertex blocks, so K3=D_q^{*(2q)}. Degree reasons annihilate successive positive-degree persistence maps (q>=3, including q=3 overlap handled by summing sphere counts).
